declarations.description:
One participant of a call, as Meet, Zoom and Teams draw them: their video, or their avatar while the camera is off,
with their name, a live microphone meter and their status.

`stream` (a `MediaStream`, property only) plays in an inner `<video>`, always muted: the call's audio is the app's to
play, as every call SDK does, and playing it twice echoes. An SDK that attaches its own `<video>` element puts it in
the default slot instead. `local` mirrors the reader's own camera and adds "(You)" to the name; `kind="screen"` shows
a screen share, fitted inside the tile and never mirrored. Without a live video track, or with `video-off`, the tile
shows a `c2-avatar` of `avatar-src` or the name's initials.

The name pill ends with the microphone: a three-bar `c2-audio-visualizer` of `stream`'s audio (or of `level`, from the
SDK), or a struck-through microphone when `muted`. `speaking` draws the accent outline; set it from the SDK's active
speaker, or set `detect-speaking` to let the tile's meter decide. `hand-raised`, `pinned` and a `fair` or `poor`
`connection` add their badges, and the `badge` slot adds the app's own (recording, host). The `actions` slot shows on
hover and focus, for a menu of tile actions.

The tile is a group named by the participant and their state ("Ana Ruiz, muted, hand raised"). Speaking is not part
of it, as it changes several times a second; a raised hand is announced once.

More badges beside the hand and the pin, top left.

members.name: stream
members.description: The participant's video (and audio, for the meter). Property only.

members.name: avatarSrc
members.description: The picture on the camera-off surface. The name's initials without it.

members.name: videoOff
members.description: The participant's camera is off, whatever `stream` holds.

members.name: local
members.description: The reader's own tile: mirrored, and "(You)" after the name.

members.name: speaking
members.description: The participant is speaking: the accent outline.

members.name: detectSpeaking
members.description: Lets the tile's own meter decide when the participant speaks, from `stream` or `level`.

members.name: level
members.description: An audio level from 0 to 1 for the meter, for an SDK that reports one; `stream` wins over it.

members.name: connection
members.description: Connection quality; `fair` and `poor` show signal bars.

members.name: trackRevision
members.description: Bumped when a track of `stream` starts, ends, mutes or unmutes, so liveness is read again.

members.name: isSpeaking
members.description: Whether the tile shows the participant as speaking, from `speaking` or its own meter.

members.name: hasVideo
members.description: Whether there is a video to show: a slotted element, or a live, enabled video track.

members.name: watchStream
members.description: Follows the tracks of the stream, so a camera turned off or a track ended swaps the video for the avatar.
